title: Telegram Desktop data folder
whyItMatters: Telegram Desktop keeps the signed-in account, cached chats, photos and files locally. The tdata folder is enough to open the account on another computer.
source: Telegram Desktop is open source and keeps its working folder (tdata) in the app-data folder: https://github.com/telegramdesktop/tdesktop
notes: Standard installed build. A portable build keeps tdata next to Telegram.exe, the Microsoft Store build uses Telegram Desktop UWP under %APPDATA%, and a custom working directory moves it. A local passcode encrypts the key data.

cleanup.exportFirst: Save any chat, photo or file you need first; Telegram Desktop keeps the only local copy on this PC.
cleanup.signOut: In Telegram, open Settings and end this computer in Active Sessions, so the account no longer trusts it.
steps: Uninstall Telegram Desktop from Settings > Apps > Installed apps.
Delete the Telegram data folder named in the plan if it is still there.
cleanup.risk: Removes cached chats, media and the local sign-in data; the account stays active on your phone.
cleanup.source: Telegram FAQ, How do I log out: https://telegram.org/faq#q-how-do-i-log-out
